tax.text: Joyce pushed to make the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act reductions permanent for individuals and small businesses.
tax.quote: Why in the world would we want to cut taxes for large corporations, but not make sure many of you who operate on main street reap the same rewards?

trade.text: Joyce backed President Trump's tariffs on China, predicting long-term success from the trade pressure.
trade.quote: This is going to be a rocky road in the short-term, but going into the long-term we're going to see success from this.

immigration.text: Joyce voted for border funding and calls for building the wall and closing asylum loopholes.
immigration.quote: this bill will provide much needed resources to the hardworking men and women in law enforcement stationed on our southern border

guns.text: Joyce voted against House Democrats' expanded background-check bills, calling them a burden on law-abiding citizens.
guns.quote: Today I voted to reject House Democrats' challenges to the fundamental right to keep and bear arms.

abortion.text: Joyce describes himself as staunchly pro-life and says unborn life is worthy of protection.
abortion.quote: Each life born and unborn is a precious gift from God that is worthy of our protection.

energy.text: Joyce says he is working to roll back energy regulations and lower energy costs while protecting energy jobs.
energy.quote: Dr. Joyce is working to rollback burdensome regulations, lower energy costs for American families, and create family-sustaining energy jobs in our region.
